newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha edges up as crude rebounds.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha edges up as crude rebounds.

text.p: NWE naphtha prices were steady to slightly firmer on Tuesday lifted by stronger crude prices after they rebounded from late losses on Monday.

Traders said early business was very thin with tight freight space continuing to hamper trade across Europe for handy sized cargoes. However, they said the market was finding some support in transatlantic arbitrage activity with some traders seen putting together large parcels for the U.S.
Skikda and Alexandria material was available, but the shortage of vessels was pushing traders out of a market already limited by quiet end-user demand, he said.
NWE cargoes were assessed notionally steady at $218/$222 cif while firmer crude saw bids for February paper $1 up at $218 while offers held at $221 a tonne cif NWE.
